Name: Em's Dinosaurs
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Eight dinosaurs to hatch in the coop from the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Dinosaur_Egg]dinosaur egg[/url]
Optional configs for the egg, mayo, and incubation time and more[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]
[/url]Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

The different types are:
Parasaur (long horn)
Triceratops (bony frill with three horns)
Spino (spine sail)
Tyranno (green)
Bronto (long neck)
Ankylo (armoured plates)
Stego (pepper rex)
Dragon (green dragon)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Dinos CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When hatching a dino, the type gets randomised and can be any of the eight options
See the config options part for more

If you rather choose which type you get, you can download ﻿"Em's Dinos CP Config" instead
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a config.json

The default is the Triceratops. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Dino mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Triceratops[/color]" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/t4WmhZtr/Dino-Config.png[/img]

These configs are all ﻿optional. If you leave them on default, nothing changes from vanilla

Incubation time: 2500 (1 day), 7500 (3 days), 12500 (5 days), 18000 (7 days)
Mayonnaise option: changes the look of the dino mayo
Egg option: ﻿8 options to change the look of the dinosaur egg
Type: changes the name of dino's and their products from "dino" to "dragon"

If you don't want to wait to get the dinosaur egg, try out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22008]Buyable Dinosaurs and Ostriches[/url]
This allows you to get dinosaurs from Marnie, including config options
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]
